change_summary: NBA shared game simulation research challenger: conservation-aware player points, isolated RNG, explicit settlement, finite input validation and draw-content hashing; 19 synthetic model regression tests. No release or real-data validation.
assumptions: Constants are calibrated to the analytic model scale, not fitted to outcomes.
Not wired into live cards; needs player minutes/rate inputs.
Player point budgets are sequentially allocated in stable-ID order; this enforces feasibility but is not an empirically calibrated player model.
Display-name fallback is research-only; production requires verified stable athlete IDs.
Six new adversarial tests are added; the 9-case golden fixture remains separately pinned.

baseline.metric: Prior NBA shared simulator lacked team/player point conservation, independent player RNG, bounded inputs and draw-content hashes
